abstract: Three patients are described with defects of blastogenesis and predominantly midline defects. Two were sibs of whom the firstborn were female cephalothoracopagus-conjoined twins with multiple predominantly midline defects initially thought to be a sporadic occurrence. A subsequent brother presented with severe hydrocephalus, rhombencephalosynapsis, conotruncal defect, ambiguous genitalia, and unilateral pre-axial polydactyly; an autosomal recessive defect is postulated in this case. Patient 3 had hydrocephalus, small cerebellum, cleft lip and palate, and a large sacrococcygeal teratoma, the better differentiated part of which included ovarian tissue with primordial follicles. The latter may occur in incomplete twinning as a defect of blastogenesis. The mother had had a previous termination of a fetus with hydrocephalus from a different relationship. Counseling was difficult since no examinations were done on the previous fetus and no further investigations of this family could be obtained, but a genetic origin is suspected. Most defects of blastogenesis are sporadic; however, some cases have a genetic cause and ultrasound examinations should be offered in subsequent pregnancies.
abstract_ja: 3例の胚発生異常(blastogenesis defects)を報告し、主に正中線の奇形を認めた。2例は同胞で、第1子は正中線を中心とした多発奇形を伴う女性の頭胸部結合双生児であり、当初は散発例と考えられた。その後に生まれた男児は重度の水頭症、菱脳癒合症、円錐動脈幹欠損、両性器異常、片側性の軸前性多指症を示し、常染色体劣性遺伝が疑われた。症例3は水頭症、小脳の低形成、口唇口蓋裂を伴い、大型の仙尾部奇形腫を有していた。その奇形腫のより分化した部分には、原始卵胞を含む卵巣組織が見られた。後者は不完全双生児形成における胚発生異常として生じた可能性がある。母親は別のパートナーとの間に、水頭症の胎児の人工妊娠中絶歴がある。その胎児は検査されていないため、カウンセリングは困難であった。家族のさらなる調査も得られなかったが、遺伝的起源が疑われる。ほとんどの胚発生異常は散発的であるが、一部は遺伝的原因を有するため、以後の妊娠では超音波検査を提供すべきである。
